pages.text: $(l)Quicklime$(), burned from calcite or bone blocks, is the physician's friend. Scattered on blighted ground it cleans a patch at once. It fills Plague Pits. It dissolves a corpse as surely as fire.
A lit $(l)Herb Brazier$() fed with flowers keeps a wide circle clean: no Blight, no miasma, and nests inside it fall quiet. Its edge is marked by drifting ash.
